description: Press or long-press a TV remote button on Android TV, tvOS, or Vega OS. Android TV also supports volume, power, media, channel, guide, captions, input, color keys, and android-keycode:N. tvOS and Vega OS support up, down, left, right, select, menu, home, and back. Phones and WebDriver sessions are unsupported. The aliases ok, center, and enter map to select. Times out after 90s.

button.description: TV remote button. Android TV also accepts android-keycode:<n> with n from 1 to 2147483647.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

durationMs.description: Press duration in milliseconds. tvOS and Vega OS use the exact hold duration; Android TV maps any positive value to an ADB longpress (longpress).

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: tv-remote
